description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer: stock, price and delivery time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Delivery" name="Parts batch delivery"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Query" name="Query parts" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Msg_Query"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Offer" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="CatchEvent_Offers" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderOne" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderOne" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSeveral" name="Order" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveral" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_FirstBatch" name="First batch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NextBatch" name="Next batch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="CatchEvent_NextBatch" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Need" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query web shops for stock, price and delivery time"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_Offers" name="Offers received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Offers" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateList" name="Create list of parts to order per shop"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Enough" name="Enough parts at one shop?" default="Flow_NotEnough"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderOne" name="Order all parts from one shop (cheapest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSeveral" name="Order parts from several shops (cheapest parts)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge" name="Orders placed"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_FirstParts" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstParts" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock handled"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildDone" name="Building finished?" default="Flow_NotDone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Built" name="Building finished"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_NextBatch" name="Next batch of parts arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NextBatch" messageRef="Msg_Delivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck" name="Stock of a part?" default="Flow_Sufficient"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder parts (cheapest)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder parts (fastest)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Complain" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Need" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="CatchEvent_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers" sourceRef="CatchEvent_Offers" targetRef="Task_CreateList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_List" sourceRef="Task_CreateList" targetRef="Gateway_Enough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Enough" targetRef="Task_OrderOne">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${singleShopSufficient}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEnough" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Enough" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveral"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderOneMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderOne" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSeveralMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveral" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrdersToArrival" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstToBuild" sourceRef="CatchEvent_FirstParts" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuildToStock" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockToDone" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Gateway_BuildDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Done" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildDone" targetRef="EndEvent_Built">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${buildingFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDone" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildDone" targetRef="CatchEvent_NextBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BatchToCheck" sourceRef="CatchEvent_NextBatch" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderCheapest" name="Stock below 5 (not below 3)" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderFastest" name="Stock below 3 (not zero)" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complain" name="Stock zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_Complain">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sufficient" name="Stock sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderCheapestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReorderFastestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplainMerge" sourceRef="Task_Complain" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
